steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$has_gallery = false;
foreach ( wc_get_products( array( 'limit' => -1 ) ) as $product ) {
	$image_ids = get_posts(
		array(
			'post_type'      => 'attachment',
			'post_status'    => 'inherit',
			'post_parent'    => $product->get_id(),
			'post_mime_type' => 'image',
			'fields'         => 'ids',
			'posts_per_page' => -1,
			'orderby'        => 'ID',
			'order'          => 'ASC',
		)
	);

	$gallery_ids = array_values( array_diff( array_map( 'absint', $image_ids ), array( $product->get_image_id() ) ) );
	$product->set_gallery_image_ids( $gallery_ids );
	$product->save();

	if ( $product->get_image_id() && $gallery_ids ) {
		$has_gallery = true;
	}
}

if ( ! $has_gallery ) {
	throw new RuntimeException( 'No WooCommerce sample products with featured and gallery images were imported.' );
}
